name: Barbarian audit: Athleticism and Efficient Killer are native resource auras (#2008, #3305)
contract: #2008 Athleticism (560456) is a single SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_REGEN_PERCENT (110, amount 25, MiscValue 3 = Energy) effect. Its handler AuraEffect::HandleModPowerRegenPCT calls HandleModPowerRegen, which for POWER_ENERGY calls Player::UpdateEnergyRegen immediately and is otherwise consumed by Player::Regenerate every tick; there is no harness metric for the live regen rate, so only the aura and its amount are asserted as native, data-driven proof that the correct percentage reaches the engine. #3305 Efficient Killer (803085) is SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT (72, amount -10, MiscValue 127 = all schools). AuraEffect::HandleModPowerCostPCT applies -0.10 to UNIT_FIELD_POWER_COST_MULTIPLIER for every school bit set, and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost multiplies powerCost by (1 + powerCostMultiplier) for the spell's own school. Skull Smash (560532, PowerType 3 = Energy, ManaCost 30, no ManaCostPercentage) is used as the probe spell since it is a Barbarian ability with a real flat Energy cost; the spell_power_cost metric calls CalcPowerCost directly, so 30 must become int32(30 * 0.90) = 27 once Efficient Killer is learned.
